config.title: A Grassland Food Chain
config.passage: In a grassland, the sun's energy helps the grass grow. Grasshoppers eat the grass, and frogs eat the grasshoppers. Snakes then eat the frogs. When any of these living things die, tiny decomposers break them down, returning nutrients to the soil so new grass can grow.
